question.problem:
What is the $8$th term of the following arithmetic sequence?

$$
4, \: 7, \: 10, \: 13, \: 16, \: \ldots
$$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14203588/assets/ac878a3d258fa19641d983863580af953bbea593b49bffff16f2f09eb7b6ab2d.png)

We notice that the sequence is an arithmetic sequence with a common difference of 

$$
d=7-4=3.
$$

So, we can calculate each term in the sequence by adding $3$ to the previous term. 

We will continue listing terms of the sequence until we get to the $8$th term. Listing the terms up to the $8$th term, we have:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14203588/assets/e536739b28db7d0f221967ce8729eee502a29f80caec8e1c39f61a9cfe4a6459.png)

Therefore, the $8$th term is $25.$
